findings: All six actual output sets were independently recaptured from FASTA/stats and matched their current per-run receipts.
Default output delivers 60 records: 26 standard and 34 uncertain; opt-out delivers the same 26 standard records. Sample totals are 11+17 Gryllus, 9+4 Drosophila and 6+13 Heliconius.

Standard headers and sequences match prior output exactly after removing only the new class field. Uncertain sequences, order and descriptions match exactly; full assessments match after intentional ID/output-path normalization.

Inclusive totals, class partitions, status fields and retained standard failure reasons agree with actual records. Every record is classified, standard records precede uncertain records, and all current IDs are unique within each sample.
Current manifested consumer returns exactly the standard subset. Source controls and compiled tests also cover reference bootstrap exclusion, custom target names, and owned schema-1 migration.
Current/prior output and individual receipt hashes, source/check bookends, executable identity, CPU affinity and 40-GiB address-space constraints verify. No read threading was enabled.
Final documentation correctly limits conclusions to output compatibility on three selected samples; no biological repeat correctness or performance equivalence is claimed.
limitations: The emitted uncertain records remain bounded graph-path hypotheses with unresolved repeat length and unevaluated read support. Five historical sequence matches are availability findings, not restored standard recovery.
The two missing Drosophila 12S identities are nonobservations under unchanged search/retention bounds, not absence findings.

This independent review rescanned produced FASTA/stats and receipted artifacts, not external raw FASTQ. Exact input-prefix identity and count evidence comes from the reviewed harness before/after scans.

The independent checker initially expected an additional zero-test doctest log line; actual binary-crate logs contain the three passing suites 247/23/6. That reviewer-only expectation was corrected before successful raw-output review; producer sources and completed runs were unchanged.
scope: Completed local experiment-branch delivery regression. This review does not authorize merging or release.
